decision_freeze: Accepted decisions are frozen until an ADR explicitly supersedes them; implementation convenience is not sufficient reason to reopen them.

decisions.title: Composable Platform
decisions.decision: CFIP owns domain/contracts/governance; OSS supplies reusable capabilities behind adapters.

decisions.title: Modular Monolith First
decisions.decision: Start with explicit bounded contexts and extract services only with measurable scale, isolation, ownership or security justification.

decisions.title: NATS JetStream Baseline
decisions.decision: NATS JetStream is the baseline event plane; alternatives require benchmark evidence and ADR.

decisions.title: Evidence Core IP
decisions.decision: Evidence, provenance, trust, freshness, claim lineage and reproducibility contracts remain CFIP-owned.

decisions.title: Elyrava Framework Neutrality
decisions.decision: Elyrava exposes stable contracts and may adapt multiple agent/model/research frameworks.

decisions.title: Fork Last
decisions.decision: Use upstream, adapter, extension or upstream patch before fork; fork only with documented ownership and maintenance plan.

decisions.title: OSS Popularity Is Not Evidence
decisions.decision: Stars, hype, vendor branding or repository count never constitute runtime adoption evidence.

decisions.title: One Production Implementation Per Capability
decisions.decision: Do not run competing search engines, vector stores, workflow engines, brokers or trading engines simultaneously without explicit architecture evidence.

decisions.title: Provider Independence
decisions.decision: Market/news/economic/broker providers are adapters; provider identity cannot become domain semantics.

decisions.title: PIT and Provenance First
decisions.decision: Historical truth, revision lineage, event-time semantics and reproducibility are mandatory for research/trading intelligence.

decisions.title: Consensus Is Authoritative
decisions.decision: Specialist engines emit evidence; one governed consensus boundary produces the platform-level analytical decision.

decisions.title: Risk Before Execution
decisions.decision: Execution is separately authorized and fail-closed; risk/account/broker constraints are evaluated before order submission.

decisions.title: Autonomy Is Governed
decisions.decision: Self-development follows proposal, isolation, verification, gates, approval when required, promotion, health guard and rollback.

decisions.title: Search Stack Must Be Benchmarked
decisions.decision: Vespa/OpenSearch/Elasticsearch/Qdrant/pgvector and alternatives remain candidates until workload-specific evidence selects a runtime composition.

decisions.title: Graph Is Optional
decisions.decision: A graph database is not assumed to be primary storage; PostgreSQL plus search/vector and projected graph capability may be sufficient.

decisions.title: Workflow Is Not Eventing
decisions.decision: NATS JetStream transports durable events; Temporal or another workflow engine is evaluated only for durable orchestration semantics.

decisions.title: License Is a Gate
decisions.decision: License compatibility is evaluated for direct and transitive dependencies before runtime adoption or redistribution.

decisions.title: Core IP Boundary
decisions.decision: FVG/OB intelligence, evidence contract, research decision model, signal fusion, calibration/outcome attribution, Elyrava governance and domain contracts remain CFIP IP.
